q = np.int32(536870912)  # -(a // 4)
result = np.gcd(a, q * 3)
probe('gcd_int32_overflow', int(result))

q64 = np.int64(-(a64 // 4))

probe('gcd_int64_overflow', int(result64))

a16 = np.int16(np.iinfo(np.int16).min)
q16 = np.int16(-(a16 // 4))
result16 = np.gcd(a16, q16 * 3)
probe('gcd_int16_overflow', int(result16))
